As-Sa'ib heard none of Talha, Sa'd, al-Miqdad and Abdur-Rahman bin Auf narrate from the Prophet, except Talha, who talked about the day of Uhud.
Umar and an Ansari friend took turns attending the Prophet, each telling the other what he had heard from him.
Umar wanted a witness for an instruction Abu Musa cited, which market business had hidden from him; Abu Huraira, staying close to the Prophet, narrated much and forgot nothing.
